# World photo assets

These photo stills were extracted from the user's uploaded video \`1000034633.mp4\` and are required local assets. Do not replace them with stock or generated image stand-ins. See \`docs/WORLD_INVENTORY.md\` for image-by-image descriptions and \`docs/WORLD_REFERENCE_MAP.md\` for their game mappings.

Missing photo or model files are reported in the red on-screen asset banner and F3 diagnostics panel.
